## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Telemetry is now disabled by default; enable explicitly with `OTEL_ENABLED=true`

* **Chores**
  * Increased Node.js heap memory allocation for improved performance and stability

* **Documentation**
  * Updated configuration documentation to reflect telemetry opt-in behavior

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

This PR makes two independent configuration changes to the typeberry toolchain: telemetry is shifted from opt-out (enabled by default unless `OTEL_ENABLED=false`) to opt-in (disabled by default, enabled only when `OTEL_ENABLED=true`), with corresponding documentation and inline comments. Simultaneously, Node.js heap size limits are uniformly increased from 6GB to 12GB across the build script, npm start script, and npm inspect script to support higher memory demand.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~8 minutes

- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#959](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/959): Related heap-size configuration changes to `bin/jam/package.json` and `bin/jam/build-for-npm.sh` modifying `NODE_OPTIONS` and Node shebang settings.
